en.name: Removable Orthodontic Appliances
en.meta_title: Removable Orthodontic Appliances: Retainers & Active Plates
en.meta_description: Learn about removable orthodontic appliances, including retainers to maintain your straight smile after braces, and active appliances used for early interceptive treatment in younger patients.
en.meta_keywords: removable orthodontic appliances, dental retainers, orthodontic retainer, expansion plate, orthodontics, teeth straightening

what_are.heading: What Are Removable Orthodontic Appliances?
paragraphs: Removable orthodontic appliances play a crucial role in both active treatment and the retention phase of orthodontics. These custom-made devices are designed to be taken in and out of the mouth by the patient and serve a variety of purposes.

types.heading: Types of Appliances: Active and Passive
paragraphs: Active appliances, such as expansion plates or spring aligners, can be used to achieve specific, limited tooth movements, often in younger patients during early interceptive treatment. The most common type of passive removable appliance is the retainer. After your braces or Invisalign treatment is complete, a retainer is essential for maintaining your newly straightened smile.

function.heading: Maintaining Your Perfect Smile
paragraphs: A retainer holds the teeth in their new positions while the surrounding bone and ligaments stabilize, preventing them from relapsing. At LUNAI, we provide various types of durable and comfortable removable appliances, custom-fitted to ensure they are effective and easy to wear as prescribed.
